thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: synthetic-liveness-checks eu-west-1 - failure rate 75% (15/20) over 3m. PagerDuty P0 routed to SRE-EU. https://observability.internal/redwood/synth/eu-west-1

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-7621 created and routed to schedule: SRE-EU. Pager: @oncall-eu

maya: acked. I'm on call, standing up. first check: are user-facing services impacted?

simon: I see no customer-facing errors in dashboards. Only synthetic probes failing. Latency for real traffic is steady.

kim: seen the probe errors in logs: connecting -> connection refused to prober-backend:5042, repeated. suspect backend pool unhealthy.

maya: pulling prober logs now. tail from the most recent pod: ```
2026-03-15T10:02:04Z ERROR connect to prober-backend:5042: connection refused
2026-03-15T10:02:05Z WARN probe fanout attempt failed, retrying
2026-03-15T10:02:06Z ERROR upstream cluster returned 503
```

simon: interesting, there was an edge config change 6m ago that altered healthcheck routing for the prober-backend pool. Change landed in global-lb-config: roll/2026-03-15-1000.

maya: can we roll that config back quickly? if it's routing probes to the wrong port that matches the connection refused.

simon: initiating rollback now. command: `infra-cli config rollback global-lb-config roll/2026-03-15-1000`

incident-bot: Configuration rollback initiated by simon at 2026-03-15T10:06:12Z. Watch for propagation ~30-90s.

maya: scaling synth-prober deployment to reduce fanout pressure while this propagates: ```kubectl -n synthetic scale deploy/synth-prober-eu --replicas=6```

kim: scaling done. also toggled probe-fanout to conservative mode (1x) via feature flag: `ffctl set synth.fanout_mode conservative --env eu-west-1`

oncall-eu: taking oncall handoff in 10m if this persists. @eve-oncall can you standby for a handoff?

eve-oncall: standing by. if rollback doesn't fix it in 2m we'll consider restarting the prober-backend pool and escalating to infra for host-level checks.

maya: rollback reported propagated. monitoring indicates error rate dropping in prober logs. synthetic fail count now 6/20 (30%).

pagerduty: INC-7621 acknowledged by maya. Escalation suppressed.

maya: continuing to watch. still seeing a handful of 503s. running a controlled restart on the prober-backend pods: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart sts/prober-backend-sts --timeout=5m```

simon: restart in progress. tail shows pods coming back healthy and passing healthchecks.

maya: synthetic failure rate down to 0/20. checks green across eu-west-1.

incident-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: synthetic-liveness-checks eu-west-1 resolved at 2026-03-15T10:11:07Z. Incident will auto-close in PagerDuty.

maya: summary: root cause was an edge load-balancer config that accidentally changed healthcheck routing for prober-backend (deploy roll earlier at 10:00). Mitigation: rollback of global-lb-config + scale + conservative fanout + restart of prober-backend. No customer-facing impact observed.

maya: follow-ups: 1) create a postmortem if we see recurrence (TICKET-4589). 2) add an automated check to validate lb healthcheck mapping as part of config rollouts. 3) add a runbook step to suppress PD noise for synthetic waves when root-cause is config propagation.

eve-oncall: taking notes and will file the follow-up. closing oncall handover now.

simon: adding config rollout guard to infra CI.

maya: thanks team, closing thread. :thumbsup:
